facts.value: Are you interested in clever designs that benefit people’s lives?

Are you a hands-on person?
Design and Manufacture Engineering covers a range of topics which are directly relevant to solving big real-world problems.

metadata.chunk_title: What is a Bachelor of Engineering in Design and Manufacture?

facts.value: Graduates will design useful working products, seeing them developed from possibility and concept, through the practicalities of manufacture, to real use, and eventual recycling after their life’s end.

Cian Hogan chose Design and Manufacture Engineering for a mix of technical drawing and problem-solving skills. Practical knowledge of current practices and equipment used in the manufacturing industry was gained, including CAD software SolidWorks, electrical and pneumatic systems, and 3D printing methods.
Cian Hogan completed an 8-month Co-op Placement at Modular Automation, contributed to innovative design in industry, and gained a Mechanical Design Engineer position after graduation.

Lisa Daly chose Design and Manufacture Engineering to learn about product innovation, design considerations, and sustainable manufacturing. Gained project management skills during her Co-op placement with Abbott Diagnostics.
